nodes.label: Toaster Theme Provider Compatibility
nodes.rationale: The mounted Refine UI toaster reads the custom theme provider; the alternative Sonner component depends on next-themes and cannot replace it without adding that provider.

nodes.label: Token Key Stability
nodes.rationale: The localStorage keys are load-bearing and must remain stable because saved administrator sessions depend on them.

nodes.label: Devtools Production Gate
nodes.rationale: Refine devtools are gated by import.meta.env.DEV so they are tree-shaken from production builds.

nodes.label: Route Loading Strategy
nodes.rationale: Route pages are loaded as React.lazy chunks through Suspense, while the authenticated Dashboard landing route remains static.

nodes.label: Base Path Strategy
nodes.rationale: BrowserRouter and unauthenticated redirects derive their prefixes from BASE_URL so development runs at root while the embedded build runs under /platform.

nodes.label: Embedded Production Build
nodes.rationale: The default production build is written into the API static directory with emptyOutDir disabled so sibling API static files are preserved.

nodes.label: Manual Chunk Strategy
nodes.rationale: Production dependencies and lazy route pages are split into targeted chunks to reduce initial JavaScript; broad Radix, Lucide, or Sonner groups are avoided because they would pull lazy-route members into the initial load.

nodes.label: No Test Task Policy
nodes.rationale: The app intentionally has no test runner or test files, and Turborepo skips packages that do not declare a test script, so a test task should not be added.
